content.title: Register a shopper account
content.description: A new shopper submits registration details, is blocked on malformed email input or an unticked privacy policy with field-level errors and no account creation, and on valid unique details reaches an account-created confirmation state.
content.value: Enables account-based shopping while preventing invalid or non-compliant registrations.
criteria: Registration rejects a malformed email address and an unticked privacy policy with a field-level error, and does not create the account.
Registration with valid unique details lands on an account-created confirmation.
